rhs_for_integrator: Msat * tanh((H + alpha_mf * Msat * tanh(H / H0) - N_demag * Msat * tanh((H + alpha_mf * Msat * tanh(H / H0)) / (H0 * (1 + beta_T * (T / Tc)) * (1 - (T / Tc)**gamma_c)))) / (H0 * (1 + beta_T * (T / Tc)) * (1 - (T / Tc)**gamma_c))) * (1 - sigma_fluc * (T / Tc)**delta_c / (1 + (H / H0)**2)) + M_rem * exp(-Abs(H) / H_c) * tanh(H_c / (H0 * (1 - (T / Tc)**gamma_c) + eps_reg)) * sign_bias
sanity_expectations: M stays finite and real over the whole region (|M| <~ Msat + M_rem ~ 1.2)
At fixed T, M increases monotonically with H and saturates toward ~Msat for large H
Near H=0 the remanent contribution offsets M by up to ~M_rem*sign_bias (~+0.2)
Increasing T (toward Tc) reduces the effective response via thermal broadening and spin-wave suppression
No divergence: T kept in [0.1,0.9]*Tc so (1-(T/Tc)^gamma_c) stays positive and denominators finite
excitation_report: sigma=0.01 (abs std on M, ~1% of Msat). excitation_check (sobol, 512 samples, 2D): main tanh/mean-field term rms=0.951 (95.1x sigma); remanent term rms=0.062 (6.2x sigma); NO weak terms. NEW term (E - parent = M_rem*exp(-|H|/H_c)*tanh(H_c/(H0*(1-(T/Tc)^gamma_c)+eps_reg))*sign_bias) peak effect 0.198 = 19.8x sigma, strongest near H~0.012, T~0.59 — inside the sampled region since H starts at 0 where the remanent term maximizes. All terms visible.
role_corrections: M: output->output (confirmed dependent variable, explicit LHS, not on RHS)
H: input-axis->independent variable (confirmed; primary field-sweep axis, ranged)
T: input-axis->independent variable (confirmed; second sampling axis exciting all thermal terms)
Msat: input-axis->parameter (overridden: material saturation constant, fixed at 1.0)
H0: input-axis->parameter (overridden: characteristic field-scale constant, fixed at 1.0)
rationale: Structure is fully explicit in M (analyze_expression: no derivatives, no integral kernels, target absent from RHS, explicitly solvable) -> equation_type=explicit, integrator=evaluate_explicit. H and T are the physical sampling axes; Msat and H0 are material constants fixed as parameters. Parameter values chosen in natural units (Msat=H0=Tc=1) with physically sensible dimensionless couplings; suggested ranges for M_rem, H_c, eps_reg, sign_bias adopted. excitation_check confirmed every additive term and the new remanent term exceed 5*sigma, so the benchmark is not degenerate to the parent.

scenario_text: A ferromagnetic sample is placed in an external magnetic field that is slowly increased, and its magnetization rises toward a saturation limit. As more magnetic domains align, the remaining unaligned fraction shrinks and further gains diminish. We measure the equilibrium magnetization at various applied field strengths. The saturation magnetization and a characteristic field set the response curve.
